name: After § 12
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 17n. Notes with concern that only 14 % of the reduced Heading 1 allocation is earmarked for ‘social investments’; insists that this percentage is inadequate to meet the scale of current social challenges; calls for a stand-alone ESF with a dedicated and ring-fenced financial envelope, which ensures the achievement of all the objectives of the European Pillar of Social Rights;
